INSERT INTO payroll_detail (batch_id, employee_id, calc_status, gross_salary, net_salary, detail_json, anomaly_flags, prev_net_salary, manual_adjusted) VALUES
(#{item.batchId}, #{item.employeeId}, #{item.calcStatus}, #{item.grossSalary}, #{item.netSalary}, #{item.detailJson}, #{item.anomalyFlags}, #{item.prevNetSalary}, #{item.manualAdjusted})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE calc_status = VALUES(calc_status), gross_salary = VALUES(gross_salary), net_salary = VALUES(net_salary), detail_json = VALUES(detail_json), anomaly_flags = VALUES(anomaly_flags), manual_adjusted = VALUES(manual_adjusted)
